calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, cp.category AS cur_cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT cur_cat, cur_sub, subcategory AS sub_then, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, sum(quantity) AS qty, min(quantity) minq, max(quantity) maxq, count(DISTINCT sku) skus, min(sale_date) mind, max(sale_date) maxd, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) staffq
FROM l WHERE cur_sub ILIKE '%paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) nid, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rec, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) maxload
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(l.sale_date, r.business_date) d, l.n, l.nid, l.rec, r.receipts, l.units, r.units_sold, l.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, round(l.net - r.net_sales_before_returns,2) diff, l.minload, l.maxload
FROM l FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') r ON r.business_date=l.sale_date
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'sold' k, sum(f.quantity) q FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returned_in_period', sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
